verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a pricing-page line advertising "Advanced call summaries, including custom summaries," which suggests some user control over summary format. Nothing shows templates or saved prompts, or how they would be assigned per meeting type such as discovery call, 1:1 or standup. Missing for 10: documented custom template/prompt creation, per-meeting-type assignment or auto-selection, detail on how custom summaries are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
